policy: Intended concealed seating overlaps only. Exposed coplanar layers and moving-part penetrations prohibited. Walls omitted; supply and waste endpoints assume installation wall.

supports: floor -> ceramic skirt -> ceramic bowl -> rear deck -> cistern gasket -> cistern -> cover
bowl rim -> four seat bumpers -> seat ring
seat ring -> two lid bumpers -> lid
rear deck/bowl -> fixed hinge feet/pedestals -> common coaxial pin -> separate seat/lid barrels -> arms -> seat/lid
toilet.drain: Bowl throat -> hollow curved trap -> floor socket with bottom recessed6mm inside skirt. Simplified visible structural path; not hydraulic simulation.

supports: installation wall -> two mounting brackets -> basin rear
washbasin.drain: True basin drain with strainer -> hollow tailpiece -> hollow P-trap -> open wall outlet. Overflow bore connects via return tube to tailpiece side inlet.
washbasin.supply: Wall stops -> flexible feeds -> faucet shank. No water simulation or operating mixer valve.
